comment: The panel abbreviates the intervals (m2, M2, tri, oct, 2tri, 2oct and so on) while the maker's tooltips spell them out; the lines use the spelled-out names. The loop runs over every output index, so the semitone offset is exactly the output's index and the jack the maker calls octave tritone is eighteen semitones, an augmented eleventh. Only channel 1 of a poly cable is read.
